description: Source code for the 'Module_s' class implementing a series-connected battery module with methods for calculating open circuit voltage, total resistance, voltage, setting current, and time stepping, including thermal and electrical modeling.

classes.name: Module_s
classes.description: Represents a series-connected battery module with electrical and thermal modeling capabilities.

methods.name: getOCV
methods.description: Calculates the sum of open circuit voltages of all cells in the module.

methods.name: getRtot
methods.description: Calculates the total resistance of the module including contact resistances.

methods.name: V
methods.description: Returns the total voltage of the module, calculating it if not valid.

methods.name: setCurrent
methods.description: Sets the current for all cells in the module, with optional voltage checks.

methods.name: timeStep_CC
methods.description: Performs a constant current time step, updating thermal and electrical states.
